name: xLOOT staking redeem counts the same NFT id repeatedly

classification.summary: Staking.redeem(uint256[]) totals the reward for every supplied token id, checking only ownerOf(id), before it advances nextRedeem[id], so seven owned xLOOT ids repeated 155 times each collected the freshly opened epoch reward 1,085 times.
